title: VPN
description: Adds a VPN connection: the built-in IKEv2, L2TP or IPSec client, or a VPN app.

DNS.title: DNS
DNS.description: A dictionary to use for all VPN types.

DNSProtocol.title: DNS protocol
DNSProtocol.description: The transport protocol to communicate with the DNS server.

DomainName.title: Domain name
DomainName.description: The primary domain of the tunnel.

PayloadCertificateUUID.title: DNS certificate UUID
PayloadCertificateUUID.description: That UUID that points to an identity certificate payload. The system uses this identity to authenticate the user to the DNS resolver.

SearchDomains.title: DNS search domains
SearchDomains.description: The list of domain strings used to fully qualify single-label host names.

ServerAddresses.title: DNS server addresses
ServerAddresses.description: The array of DNS server IP address strings. These IP addresses can be a mixture of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

ServerName.title: Server name
ServerName.description: The hostname of a DNS-over-TLS server to validate the server certificate, as defined in RFC 7858. If ServerAddresses isn't specified, the system uses the hostname to determine the server addresses. This key is required if the DNSProtocol is TLS.

ServerURL.title: Server URL
ServerURL.description: The URI template of a DNS-over-HTTPS server, as defined in RFC 8484, which needs to use the https:// scheme. The system uses the hostname or address in the URL to validate the server certificate. If ServerAddresses isn't specified, the system uses the hostname or address in the URL to determine the server addresses. This key is required if the DNSProtocol is HTTPS.

SupplementalMatchDomains.title: Supplemental match domains
SupplementalMatchDomains.description:
The list of domain strings used to determine which DNS queries use the DNS resolver settings in ServerAddresses. The system uses this key to create a split DNS configuration where it resolves only hosts in certain domains using the tunnel's DNS resolver. The system uses the default resolver for hosts that aren't in one of the domains in this list.

If SupplementalMatchDomains contains the empty string it becomes the default domain.

Split-tunnel configurations can direct all DNS queries to the VPN DNS servers before the primary DNS servers.

SupplementalMatchDomainsNoSearch.title: Supplemental match domains no search
SupplementalMatchDomainsNoSearch.description: If 0, append the domains in the SupplementalMatchDomains list to the resolver's list of search domains.

IKEv2.title: IKEv2 settings
IKEv2.description: The dictionary to use when VPNType is IKEv2.

AllowPostQuantumKeyExchangeFallback.title: Allow post-quantum key exchange fallback
AllowPostQuantumKeyExchangeFallback.description: If set to 0, the VPN doesn't establish a connection if the server does not support or doesn't allow post-quantum key exchanges. Thd device ignores this key if PostQuantumKeyExchangeMethods isn't present in IKESecurityAssociationParameters or ChildSecurityAssociationParameters.

AuthName.title: User name
AuthName.description: The user name to use for authentication.

AuthPassword.title: Password
AuthPassword.description: The password to use for authentication.

AuthenticationMethod.title: Authentication
AuthenticationMethod.description:
The type of authentication method for the VPN.

To enable EAP-only authentication, set this to None and ExtendedAuthEnabled to 1. If this is None and the ExtendedAuthEnabled key isn't set, the authentication configuration defaults to SharedSecret.

CertificateType.title: Certificate type
CertificateType.description: The type of PayloadCertificateUUID to use for IKEv2 machine authentication. If this key is included, the system requires a value for ServerCertificateIssuerCommonName.

DiffieHellmanGroup.title: Diffie hellman group
DiffieHellmanGroup.description:
The Diffie-Hellman group.

For AlwaysOn VPN in iOS 14.2 and later, the minimum allowed value is 14.

1, 2, and 5 are available only in iOS, macOS, and visionOS prior to iOS 26, macOS 26, and visionOS 26.

EncryptionAlgorithm.title: Encryption algorithm
EncryptionAlgorithm.description:
The encryption algorithm.

In watchOS and tvOS, the default value is AES-256-GCM.
DES and 3DES are available only in iOS, macOS, and visionOS prior to iOS 26, macOS 26, and visionOS 26.

IntegrityAlgorithm.title: Integrity algorithm
IntegrityAlgorithm.description:
The integrity algorithm.

SHA1-96 and SHA1-160 are available only in iOS, macOS, and visionOS prior to iOS 26, macOS 26, and visionOS 26.

LifeTimeInMinutes.title: Life time in minutes
LifeTimeInMinutes.description: The SA lifetime (rekey interval) in minutes.

PostQuantumKeyExchangeMethods.title: Post-quantum key exchange methods
PostQuantumKeyExchangeMethods.description: An array of integers representing postquantum key exchange methods the device uses during SA establishment and rekey. You can specify up to seven items, which correspond to ADDKE1 - ADDKE7 from RFC 9370.

DeadPeerDetectionRate.title: Dead peer detection
DeadPeerDetectionRate.description:
One of the following:

- None: No keepalive.
- Low: Send keepalive every 30 minutes.
- Medium: Send keepalive every 10 minutes.
- High: Send keepalive every 1 minute.

DisableRedirect.title: Disable redirect
DisableRedirect.description: If 1, the system disables IKEv2 redirect. If not set, the system redirects an IKEv2 connection when it receives a redirect request from the server.

DisconnectOnIdle.title: Enable disconnect on idle
DisconnectOnIdle.description: If 1, the VPN disconnects automatically after a period defined by DisconnectOnIdleTimer.

DisconnectOnIdleTimer.title: Disconnect on idle time
DisconnectOnIdleTimer.description: Only used if DisconnectOnIdle is 1. The number of seconds before the VPN disconnects. On watchOS, maximum allowed value is 15 seconds

EnableCertificateRevocationCheck.title: Enable certificate revocation check
EnableCertificateRevocationCheck.description: If 1, the system performs a certificate revocation check for IKEv2 connections. This is a best-effort revocation check and server response timeouts won't cause it to fail.

EnablePFS.title: Perfect forward secrecy
EnablePFS.description: If 1,  enables Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) for IKEv2 Connections.

EnforceRoutes.title: Enforce routes
EnforceRoutes.description: If 1, all the VPN's non-default routes take precedence over any locally-defined routes. If IncludeAllNetworks is 1, the system ignores EnforceRoutes.

EnforceStrictAlgorithmSelection.title: Enforce strict algorithm selection
EnforceStrictAlgorithmSelection.description: If set to 1, the device doesn't allow DES, 3DES, and Diffie-Hellman groups less than 14. Also the device requires the encryption algorithm specified for the IKE SA to be at least as cryptographically strong as the algorithm specified for the child SA. The device rejects this profile payload if these requirements aren't met.

ExcludeAPNs.title: Exclude APNs
ExcludeAPNs.description: If 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is 1, the system excludes network traffic for the Apple Push Notification service (APNs) from the tunnel.

ExcludeCellularServices.title: Exclude cellular services
ExcludeCellularServices.description: If 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is 1, the system excludes internet-routable network traffic for cellular services (VoLTE, Wi-Fi Calling, IMS, MMS, Visual Voicemail, etc.) from the tunnel. Note that some cellular carriers route cellular services traffic directly to the carrier network, bypassing the internet. Such cellular services traffic is always excluded from the tunnel.

ExcludeDeviceCommunication.title: Exclude device communication
ExcludeDeviceCommunication.description: If set to 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is set to 1, the device excludes network traffic used for communicating with devices connected via USB or Wi-Fi from the tunnel.

ExcludeLocalNetworks.title: Exclude local networks
ExcludeLocalNetworks.description: If 1 and either IncludeAllNetworks or EnforceRoutes are 1, then the system routes local network traffic outside of the VPN. The default for this value is 0 on macOS and 1 on iOS.

IKESecurityAssociationParameters.title: IKE security association parameters
IKESecurityAssociationParameters.description: These parameters apply to Child Security Association unless ChildSecurityAssociationParameters is specified.

DiffieHellmanGroup.title: Diffie hellman group
DiffieHellmanGroup.description:
The Diffie-Hellman group.

For AlwaysOn VPN in iOS 14.2 and later, the minimum allowed value is 14.

1, 2, and 5 are available only in iOS, macOS, and visionOS prior to iOS 26, macOS 26, and visionOS 26.

EncryptionAlgorithm.title: Encryption algorithm
EncryptionAlgorithm.description:
The encryption algorithm.

In watchOS and tvOS, the default value is AES-256-GCM.
DES and 3DES are available only in iOS, macOS, and visionOS prior to iOS 26, macOS 26, and visionOS 26.

IntegrityAlgorithm.title: Integrity algorithm
IntegrityAlgorithm.description:
The integrity algorithm.

SHA1-96 and SHA1-160 are available only in iOS, macOS, and visionOS prior to iOS 26, macOS 26, and visionOS 26.

LifeTimeInMinutes.title: Life time in minutes
LifeTimeInMinutes.description: The SA lifetime (rekey interval) in minutes.

PostQuantumKeyExchangeMethods.title: Post-quantum key exchange methods
PostQuantumKeyExchangeMethods.description: An array of integers representing postquantum key exchange methods the device uses during SA establishment and rekey. You can specify up to seven items, which correspond to ADDKE1 - ADDKE7 from RFC 9370.

IncludeAllNetworks.title: Send all traffic through the VPN
IncludeAllNetworks.description:
If 1, then the system routes all network traffic through the VPN, with some controllable exclusions, such as ExcludeLocalNetworks, ExcludeCellularServices, and ExcludeAPNs properties. The system always excludes the following traffic from the tunnel:

- Traffic necessary for connecting and maintaining the device's network connection, such as DHCP.
- Traffic necessary for connecting to captive networks.
- Certain cellular services traffic that's not routable over the internet and is instead directly routed to the cellular network. See the ExcludeCellularServices field for more information.

MTU.title: Maximum transmission unit
MTU.description: The Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) specifies the maximum size in bytes of each packet that the system sends over the IKEv2 VPN interface.

NATKeepAliveInterval.title: NAT keepalive interval
NATKeepAliveInterval.description: The NAT Keepalive interval for Always On VPN IKEv2 connections. This value controls the interval that the device sends keepalive offload packets. The minimum value is 20 seconds. If no key is specified, the default is 20 seconds over Wi-Fi and 110 seconds over a cellular interface.

NATKeepAliveOffloadEnable.title: NAT keep alive offload enable
NATKeepAliveOffloadEnable.description:
If 1, enables NAT keepalive offload for Always On VPN IKEv2 connections. The device sends keepalive packets to maintain NAT mappings for IKEv2 connections that have a NAT on the path. It sends keepalive packets at regular intervals when the device is awake. If NATKeepAliveOffloadEnable is 1, the system offloads keepalive packets to hardware while the device is asleep.

NAT keepalive offload has an impact on the battery life due to the extra workload during sleep. The default interval for the keepalive offload packets is 20 seconds over Wi-Fi and 110 seconds over Cellular interface.

OnDemandEnabled.title: Connect on demand
OnDemandEnabled.description: If 1, enables VPN up on demand.

OnDemandRules.title: On-demand rules
OnDemandRules.description: A list of rules that determine when and how to use an OnDemand VPN.

Action.title: Action
Action.description:
The action to take if this dictionary matches the current network. Possible values are:
- Allow: Deprecated. Allow VPN On Demand to connect if triggered.
- Connect: Unconditionally initiate a VPN connection on the next network attempt.
- Disconnect: Tear down the VPN connection and don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.
- EvaluateConnection: Evaluate the ActionParameters array for each connection attempt.
- Ignore: Leave any existing VPN connection up, but don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.

ActionParameters.title: Action parameters
ActionParameters.description: An array of dictionaries that provides rules similar to the OnDemandRules dictionary, but evaluated on each connection instead of when the network changes. This value is only for use with dictionaries in which the Action value is EvaluateConnection. The system evaluates these dictionaries in order and the first dictionary that matches determines the behavior. Not available in watchOS.

DomainAction.title: Domain action
DomainAction.description:
Defines the VPN behavior for the specified domains. Allowed values are:
* 'ConnectIfNeeded': The specified domains should trigger a VPN connection attempt if domain name resolution fails, such as when the DNS server indicates that it can't resolve the domain, responds with a redirection to a different server, or fails to respond (timeout).
* 'NeverConnect': The specified domains should never trigger a VPN connection attempt.

Domains.title: Domains
Domains.description: The domains to apply this evaluation.

RequiredDNSServers.title: Required DNS servers
RequiredDNSServers.description:
An array of IP addresses of DNS servers to use for resolving the specified domains. These servers don't need to be part of the device's current network configuration. If these DNS servers aren't reachable, the system establishes a VPN connection. These DNS servers need to be either internal DNS servers or trusted external DNS servers.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

RequiredURLStringProbe.title: Required URL string probe
RequiredURLStringProbe.description:
An HTTP or HTTPS (preferred) URL to probe, using a GET request. If the URL's hostname can't be resolved, if the server is unreachable, or if the server doesn't respond with a 200 HTTP status code, the device establishes a VPN connection in response.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

DNSDomainMatch.title: DNS search domains
DNSDomainMatch.description:
An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device's search domains list.
The system supports a wildcard (\*) prefix. For example, \*.example.com matches against either mydomain.example.com or yourdomain.example.com.

DNSServerAddressMatch.title: DNS servers
DNSServerAddressMatch.description:
An array of IP addresses. This rule matches if any of the network's specified DNS servers match any entry in the array.
The system supports matching with a single wildcard. For example, 17.\* matches any DNS server in the 17.0.0.0/8 subnet.

InterfaceTypeMatch.title: Interface
InterfaceTypeMatch.description: An interface type. If specified, this rule matches only if the primary network interface hardware matches the specified type.

SSIDMatch.title: Wi-Fi names
SSIDMatch.description:
An array of SSIDs to match against the current network. If the network isn't a Wi-Fi network or if the SSID doesn't appear in this array, the match fails.
Omit this key and the corresponding array to match against any SSID.

URLStringProbe.title: Probe URL
URLStringProbe.description: A URL to probe. This rule matches when this URL is successfully fetched (returns a 200 HTTP status code) without redirection. Not available in watchOS.

PPK.title: Post-quantum pre-shared key
PPK.description: The Post-quantum Pre-shared key (PPK) the device uses for this VPN. This key is is used with VPN servers that support RFC 8784. If this key is present PPKIdentifier must also be present.

PPKIdentifier.title: Post-quantum pre-shared key identifier
PPKIdentifier.description: The identifier for the Post-quantum Pre-shared key (PPK) the device uses for this VPN. This key is is used with VPN servers that support RFC 8784. If this key is present PPK must also be present.

PPKMandatory.title: Post-quantum pre-shared key mandatory
PPKMandatory.description: If set to 1, the VPN doesn't establish a connection if the server doesn't support RFC 8784 or doesn't accept the PPK identifier specified in PPKIdentifier. The device ignores this key if PPK and PPKIdentifier aren't present.

Password.title: Account password
Password.description: The password to use for the account credentials. Only used if AuthenticationMethod is Password.

PayloadCertificateUUID.title: Payload certificate UUID
PayloadCertificateUUID.description: The UUID of the certificate payload within the same profile to use as the account credential. If the value of AuthenticationMethod is Certificate, the system sends this certificate out for IKEv2 machine authentication. If extended authentication (EAP) is used, the system sends this certificate out for EAP-TLS authentication.

ProviderBundleIdentifier.title: Provider bundle identifier
ProviderBundleIdentifier.description: If the VPNSubType field contains the bundle identifier of an app that contains multiple VPN providers of the same type (app-proxy or packet-tunnel), then the system uses this field to choose which provider to use for this configuration. If the VPN provider uses a system extension, then this field is required.

ProviderDesignatedRequirement.title: Provider designated requirement
ProviderDesignatedRequirement.description: If the VPN provider uses a system extension, then this field is required.

ProviderType.title: Provider type
ProviderType.description: If the value of this key is app-proxy, the VPN service tunnels traffic at the application layer. If the value of this key is packet-tunnel, the VPN service tunnels traffic at the IP layer.

RemoteAddress.title: Server
RemoteAddress.description: The IP address or host name of the VPN server.

ServerCertificateCommonName.title: Server certificate common name
ServerCertificateCommonName.description: The common name of the server certificate. The system uses this name to validate the certificate sent by the IKE server. If not set, the system uses the remote identifier to validate the certificate.

ServerCertificateIssuerCommonName.title: Server certificate issuer common name
ServerCertificateIssuerCommonName.description: Common Name of the server certificate issuer. If set, this field causes IKE to send a certificate request based on this certificate issuer to the server. This key is required if the CertificateType key is included and the ExtendedAuthEnabled key is 1.

SharedSecret.title: Shared secret
SharedSecret.description: If AuthenticationMethod is SharedSecret, the device uses this value for IKE authentication.

TLSMaximumVersion.title: TLS maximum version
TLSMaximumVersion.description: The maximum TLS version to use with EAP-TLS authentication.

TLSMinimumVersion.title: TLS minimum version
TLSMinimumVersion.description: The minimum TLS version to use with EAP-TLS authentication.

UseConfigurationAttributeInternalIPSubne.title: Use IPv4 / IPv6 internal subnet attributes
UseConfigurationAttributeInternalIPSubne.description: If 1, negotiations should use IKEv2 Configuration Attribute INTERNAL_IP4_SUBNET and INTERNAL_IP6_SUBNET.

IPSec.title: IPSec settings
IPSec.description: The dictionary that contains IPSec settings. Not available in watchOS.

AuthenticationMethod.title: Authentication method
AuthenticationMethod.description: The authentication method for L2TP and Cisco IPSec.

DisconnectOnIdle.title: Enable disconnect on idle
DisconnectOnIdle.description: If 1, disconnect after an on-demand connection idles.

DisconnectOnIdleTimer.title: Disconnect on idle time
DisconnectOnIdleTimer.description: The length of time to wait before disconnecting an on-demand connection.

LocalIdentifier.title: Local identifier
LocalIdentifier.description:
The name of the group. For hybrid authentication, the string needs to end with "hybrid".

Present only for Cisco IPSec if AuthenticationMethod is SharedSecret.

LocalIdentifierType.title: Local identifier type
LocalIdentifierType.description: Present only if AuthenticationMethod is SharedSecret. The value is KeyID. The system uses this value for L2TP and Cisco IPSec VPNs.

OnDemandEnabled.title: Enable VPN on demand
OnDemandEnabled.description: If 1, enables bringing the VPN connection up on demand.

OnDemandMatchDomainsAlways.title: On demand match domains always
OnDemandMatchDomainsAlways.description: Deprecated. A list of domain names. In iOS 7 and later, if this key is present, the system treats associated domain names as though they're associated with the OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry key. This behavior can be overridden by OnDemandRules.

OnDemandMatchDomainsNever.title: On demand match domains never
OnDemandMatchDomainsNever.description: Deprecated. A list of domain names. In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of EvaluateConnection actions in the OnDemandRules dictionaries.

OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry.title: On demand match domains on retry
OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry.description: Deprecated. A list of domain names. In iOS 7 and later, this field is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of EvaluateConnection actions in the OnDemandRules dictionaries.

Action.title: On demand action
Action.description:
The action to take if this dictionary matches the current network. Possible values are:
- Allow: Deprecated. Allow VPN On Demand to connect if triggered.
- Connect: Unconditionally initiate a VPN connection on the next network attempt.
- Disconnect: Tear down the VPN connection and don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.
- EvaluateConnection: Evaluate the ActionParameters array for each connection attempt.
- Ignore: Leave any existing VPN connection up, but don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.

This value is only for use with dictionaries in which the Action value is EvaluateConnection. The system evaluates these dictionaries in order and the first dictionary that matches determines the behavior. Not available in watchOS.

Domains.title: Domains
Domains.description: The domains to apply this evaluation.

RequiredDNSServers.title: Required DNS servers
RequiredDNSServers.description:
An array of IP addresses of DNS servers to use for resolving the specified domains. These servers don't need to be part of the device's current network configuration. If these DNS servers aren't reachable, the system establishes a VPN connection. These DNS servers need to be either internal DNS servers or trusted external DNS servers.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

RequiredURLStringProbe.description:

This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

DNSDomainMatch.description:
An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device's search domains list.
The system supports a wildcard (\*) prefix. For example, \*.example.com matches against either mydomain.example.com or yourdomain.example.com.

The system supports matching with a single wildcard. For example, 17.\* matches any DNS server in the 17.0.0.0/8 subnet.

InterfaceTypeMatch.title: Interface type match
InterfaceTypeMatch.description: An interface type. If specified, this rule matches only if the primary network interface hardware matches the specified type.

SSIDMatch.title: SSID match
SSIDMatch.description:
An array of SSIDs to match against the current network. If the network isn't a Wi-Fi network or if the SSID doesn't appear in this array, the match fails.
Omit this key and the corresponding array to match against any SSID.

URLStringProbe.title: URL string probe
URLStringProbe.description: A URL to probe. This rule matches when this URL is successfully fetched (returns a 200 HTTP status code) without redirection. Not available in watchOS.

PayloadCertificateUUID.title: Certificate UUID
PayloadCertificateUUID.description:
The UUID of the certificate payload within the same profile to use for the account credentials.

Only use this with Cisco IPSec VPNs and if the AuthenticationMethod key is to Certificate.

PromptForVPNPIN.title: Prompt for PIN
PromptForVPNPIN.description: If true, prompts for a PIN when connecting to Cisco IPSec VPNs.

RemoteAddress.title: Remote address
RemoteAddress.description: The IP address or host name of the VPN server.

SharedSecret.title: Shared secret
SharedSecret.description:
The shared secret for this VPN account.

Only use this with L2TP and Cisco IPSec VPNs and if the AuthenticationMethod key is to SharedSecret.

XAuthEnabled.title: XAUTH enabled
XAuthEnabled.description: If 1, enables Xauth for Cisco IPSec VPNs.

XAuthName.title: Username
XAuthName.description: The user name for the VPN account for Cisco IPSec.

XAuthPassword.title: Password
XAuthPassword.description: The VPN account password for Cisco IPSec.

XAuthPasswordEncryption.title: XAUTH password encryption
XAuthPasswordEncryption.description: A string that either has the value "Prompt" or isn't present.

IPv4.title: IPv4 settings
IPv4.description: The dictionary that contains IPv4 settings. Not available in watchOS.

OverridePrimary.title: Override primary connection
OverridePrimary.description: If 1, the system sends all network traffic over VPN. Only applies to Cisco IPsec and L2TP VPN types.

PPP.title: PPP
PPP.description: The dictionary to use when VPNType is L2TP or PTPP. Not available in watchOS.

AuthEAPPlugins.title: EAP plugins
AuthEAPPlugins.description: An array of authentication plugins. For use of RSA SecurID, this array should only have one value: EAP-RSA. This key is for use with L2TP and PPTP networks.

AuthName.title: Account username
AuthName.description: The VPN account user name. This key is for use with L2TP and PPTP networks.

AuthPassword.title: Account password
AuthPassword.description: If TokenCard is 1, use this password for authentication. This key is for use with L2TP and PPTP networks.

AuthProtocol.title: Protocol
AuthProtocol.description: An array of authentication protocols. For use of RSA SecurID, this array should have one value, EAP. This key is for use with L2TP and PPTP networks.

CCPEnabled.title: Enable CCP
CCPEnabled.description: If 1, enables encryption on the connection. This key is for use with PPTP networks.

CCPMPPE128Enabled.title: Enable CCPMPPE128
CCPMPPE128Enabled.description: If 1 and CCPEnabled is also 1, enables CCPMPPE40 encryption.

CCPMPPE40Enabled.title: Enable CCPMPPE40
CCPMPPE40Enabled.description: If 1 and CCPEnabled is also 1, enables CCPMPPE128 encryption.

CommRemoteAddress.title: Remote address
CommRemoteAddress.description: The IP address or host name of VPN server. This key is for use with L2TP and PPTP networks.

DisconnectOnIdle.title: Enable disconnect on idle
DisconnectOnIdle.description: If 1, disconnects after an on demand connection idles.

DisconnectOnIdleTimer.title: Disconnect on idle time
DisconnectOnIdleTimer.description: The length of time to wait before disconnecting an on demand connection

TokenCard.title: Use token card
TokenCard.description: If 1, uses a token card such as an RSA SecurID card for connecting. This key is for use with L2TP networks.

Proxies.title: Proxies
Proxies.description: The dictionary to use to configure Proxies for use with VPN.

HTTPEnable.title: Enable HTTP
HTTPEnable.description: If 1, enables proxy for HTTP traffic.

HTTPPort.title: HTTP port
HTTPPort.description: The port number of the HTTP proxy. This field is required if HTTPProxy is specified.

HTTPProxy.title: HTTP proxy
HTTPProxy.description: The host name of the HTTP proxy.

HTTPProxyUsername.title: HTTP ProxyUsername
HTTPProxyUsername.description: The user name used for authentication.

HTTPSEnable.title: Enable HTTPS
HTTPSEnable.description: If true, enables proxy for HTTPS traffic.

HTTPSPort.title: HTTPS port
HTTPSPort.description: The port number of the HTTPS proxy. This field is required if HTTPSProxy is specified.

HTTPSProxy.title: HTTPS proxy
HTTPSProxy.description: The host name of the HTTPS proxy.

ProxyAutoConfigEnable.title: Proxy AutoConfig enable
ProxyAutoConfigEnable.description: If true, enables automatic proxy configuration.

ProxyAutoConfigURLString.title: Proxy server URL
ProxyAutoConfigURLString.description: The URL to the location of the proxy auto-configuration file. Used only when ProxyAutoConfigEnable is true.

ProxyAutoDiscoveryEnable.title: Proxy auto discovery enable
ProxyAutoDiscoveryEnable.description: If true, enables proxy auto discovery.

SupplementalMatchDomains.title: Supplemental match domains
SupplementalMatchDomains.description: An array of domains that defines which hosts use proxy settings for hosts.

TransparentProxy.title: Transparent proxy
TransparentProxy.description: The dictionary to use when VPNType is TransparentProxy.

AuthenticationMethod.title: Authentication method
AuthenticationMethod.description: The type of authentication method to use: Password, Certificate, or Password+Certificate.

DisconnectOnIdle.title: Enable disconnect on idle
DisconnectOnIdle.description: If 1, the VPN disconnects automatically disconnect after a period defined by DisconnectOnIdleTimer.

DisconnectOnIdleTimer.title: Disconnect on idle time
DisconnectOnIdleTimer.description: The number of seconds before the VPN disconnects. This value is only used if DisconnectOnIdle is 1.

EnforceRoutes.title: Enforce routes
EnforceRoutes.description: If 1, then all the VPN's non-default routes take precedence over any locally-defined routes. If IncludeAllNetworks is 1, the system ignores the value of EnforceRoutes.

OnDemandEnabled.title: Enable VPN on demand
OnDemandEnabled.description: If 1, the system brings up the VPN on demand.

OnDemandRules.title: On demand rules
OnDemandRules.description: Determines when and how the system uses an OnDemand VPN.

RequiredDNSServers.description:
An array of IP addresses of DNS servers to use for resolving the specified domains. These servers don't need to be part of the device's current network configuration. If these DNS servers aren't reachable, the system establishes a VPN connection. These DNS servers need to be either internal DNS servers or trusted external DNS servers.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

RequiredURLStringProbe.title: Required URL string probe
RequiredURLStringProbe.description:
An HTTP or HTTPS (preferred) URL to probe, using a GET request. If the URL's hostname can't be resolved, if the server is unreachable, or if the server doesn't respond with a 200 HTTP status code, the device establishes a VPN connection in response.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

DNSDomainMatch.title: DNS domain match
DNSDomainMatch.description:
An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device's search domains list.
The system supports a wildcard (\*) prefix. For example, \*.example.com matches against either mydomain.example.com or yourdomain.example.com.

DNSServerAddressMatch.title: DNS server address match
DNSServerAddressMatch.description:
An array of IP addresses. This rule matches if any of the network's specified DNS servers match any entry in the array.
The system supports matching with a single wildcard. For example, 17.\* matches any DNS server in the 17.0.0.0/8 subnet.

InterfaceTypeMatch.title: Interface type match
InterfaceTypeMatch.description: An interface type. If specified, this rule matches only if the primary network interface hardware matches the specified type.

SSIDMatch.title: SSID match
SSIDMatch.description:
An array of SSIDs to match against the current network. If the network isn't a Wi-Fi network or if the SSID doesn't appear in this array, the match fails.
Omit this key and the corresponding array to match against any SSID.

URLStringProbe.title: URL string probe
URLStringProbe.description: A URL to probe. This rule matches when this URL is successfully fetched (returns a 200 HTTP status code) without redirection. Not available in watchOS.

Password.title: Account password
Password.description: The password to use for the account credentials. Only used if AuthenticationMethod is Password.

PayloadCertificateUUID.title: Payload certificate UUID
PayloadCertificateUUID.description: The UUID of the identity certificate as the account credential. If AuthenticationMethod is Certificate, and extended authentication (EAP) isn't used, the device sends this certificate for IKE client authentication. If extended authentication is used, this certificate can be used for EAP-TLS.

ProviderBundleIdentifier.title: Provider bundle identifier
ProviderBundleIdentifier.description: If the VPNSubType field contains the bundle identifier of an app that contains multiple VPN providers of the same type (app-proxy or packet-tunnel), then the system uses this field to choose which provider to use for this configuration. If the VPN provider uses a system extension, then this field is required.

ProviderDesignatedRequirement.title: Provider designated requirement
ProviderDesignatedRequirement.description: If the VPN provider uses a system extension, then this field is required.

ProviderType.title: Provider type
ProviderType.description: If the value of this key is app-proxy, the VPN service tunnels traffic at the application layer. If the value of this key is packet-tunnel, the VPN service tunnels traffic at the IP layer.

UserDefinedName.title: Connection name
UserDefinedName.description: The description of the VPN connection that the system displays on the device. Not available in watchOS.

VPN.title: App-based VPN settings
VPN.description: The dictionary to use when VPNType is VPN.

AuthPassword.title: Password
AuthPassword.description: The VPN account password. Only use this if AuthenticationMethod is set to Password.

DisconnectOnIdle.title: Enable disconnect on idle
DisconnectOnIdle.description: If 1, disconnects after an on-demand connection idles.

DisconnectOnIdleTimer.title: Disconnect on idle time
DisconnectOnIdleTimer.description: The length of time to wait, in seconds, before disconnecting an on-demand connection. In watchOS, the maximum allowed value is 15.

EnforceRoutes.title: Enforce routes
EnforceRoutes.description:
If 1, all the VPN's non-default routes take precedence over any locally defined routes.

If IncludeAllNetworks is 1, the system ignores the value of EnforceRoutes.

ExcludeAPNs.title: Exclude APNs
ExcludeAPNs.description: If 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is 1, then the system excludes the network traffic for the Apple Push Notification service (APNs) from the tunnel. Not available in watchOS.

ExcludeCellularServices.title: Exclude cellular services
ExcludeCellularServices.description: If 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is 1, then the system excludes internet-routable network traffic for cellular services (VoLTE, Wi-Fi Calling, IMS, MMS, Visual Voicemail, etc.) from the tunnel. Note that some cellular carriers route cellular services traffic directly to the carrier network, bypassing the internet. Such cellular services traffic is always excluded from the tunnel. Not available in watchOS.

ExcludeDeviceCommunication.title: Exclude device communication
ExcludeDeviceCommunication.description: If set to 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is set to 1, the device excludes network traffic used for communicating with devices connected via USB or Wi-Fi from the tunnel.

ExcludeLocalNetworks.title: Exclude local networks
ExcludeLocalNetworks.description: If 1 and IncludeAllNetworks is 1, routes all local network traffic outside the VPN. Not available in watchOS.

IncludeAllNetworks.title: Send all traffic through the VPN
IncludeAllNetworks.description:
If 1, routes all traffic through the VPN, with some exclusions. Several of the exclusions can be controlled with the ExcludeLocalNetworks, ExcludeCellularServices, ExcludeAPNs and ExcludeDeviceCommunication properties. The system always excludes the following traffic from the tunnel:

- Traffic necessary for connecting and maintaining the device's network connection, such as DHCP.
- Traffic necessary for connecting to captive networks.
- Certain cellular services traffic that's not routable over the internet and is instead directly routed to the cellular network.

OnDemandMatchDomainsAlways.title: On demand match domains always
OnDemandMatchDomainsAlways.description:
A list of domain names. The system treats associated domain names as though they're associated with the OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry key. This behavior can be overridden by OnDemandRules.

In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of EvaluateConnection actions in the OnDemandRules dictionaries.

OnDemandMatchDomainsNever.title: On demand match domains never
OnDemandMatchDomainsNever.description:
A list of domain names. If the host name ends with one of these domain names, the system doesn't start the VPN automatically. The system uses this value to exclude a subdomain within an included domain.

In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of EvaluateConnection actions in the OnDemandRules dictionaries.

OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry.title: On demand match domains on retry
OnDemandMatchDomainsOnRetry.description:
A list of domain names. If the host name ends with one of these domain names and a DNS query for that domain name fails, the system starts the VPN automatically.

In iOS 7 and later, this key is deprecated (but still supported) in favor of EvaluateConnection actions in the OnDemandRules dictionaries.

OnDemandRules.title: On-demand rules
OnDemandRules.description: An array of dictionaries defining On Demand Rules.

Action.title: Action
Action.description:
The action to take if this dictionary matches the current network. Possible values are:
- Allow: Deprecated. Allow VPN On Demand to connect if triggered.
- Connect: Unconditionally initiate a VPN connection on the next network attempt.
- Disconnect: Tear down the VPN connection and don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.
- EvaluateConnection: Evaluate the ActionParameters array for each connection attempt.
- Ignore: Leave any existing VPN connection up, but don't reconnect on demand as long as this dictionary matches.

ActionParameters.title: Action parameters
ActionParameters.description: An array of dictionaries that provides rules similar to the OnDemandRules dictionary, but evaluated on each connection instead of when the network changes. This value is only for use with dictionaries in which the Action value is EvaluateConnection. The system evaluates these dictionaries in order and the first dictionary that matches determines the behavior. Not available in watchOS.

DomainAction.title: Domain action
DomainAction.description:
Defines the VPN behavior for the specified domains. Allowed values are:
* 'ConnectIfNeeded': The specified domains should trigger a VPN connection attempt if domain name resolution fails, such as when the DNS server indicates that it can't resolve the domain, responds with a redirection to a different server, or fails to respond (timeout).
* 'NeverConnect': The specified domains should never trigger a VPN connection attempt.

Domains.title: Domains
Domains.description: The domains to apply this evaluation.

RequiredDNSServers.title: Required DNS servers
RequiredDNSServers.description:
An array of IP addresses of DNS servers to use for resolving the specified domains. These servers don't need to be part of the device's current network configuration. If these DNS servers aren't reachable, the system establishes a VPN connection. These DNS servers need to be either internal DNS servers or trusted external DNS servers.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

RequiredURLStringProbe.title: Required URL string probe
RequiredURLStringProbe.description:
An HTTP or HTTPS (preferred) URL to probe, using a GET request. If the URL's hostname can't be resolved, if the server is unreachable, or if the server doesn't respond with a 200 HTTP status code, the device establishes a VPN connection in response.
This key is valid only if the value of 'DomainAction' is 'ConnectIfNeeded'.

DNSDomainMatch.title: DNS search domains
DNSDomainMatch.description:
An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device's search domains list.
The system supports a wildcard (\*) prefix. For example, \*.example.com matches against either mydomain.example.com or yourdomain.example.com.

DNSServerAddressMatch.title: DNS servers
DNSServerAddressMatch.description:
An array of IP addresses. This rule matches if any of the network's specified DNS servers match any entry in the array.
The system supports matching with a single wildcard. For example, 17.\* matches any DNS server in the 17.0.0.0/8 subnet.

InterfaceTypeMatch.title: Interface
InterfaceTypeMatch.description: An interface type. If specified, this rule matches only if the primary network interface hardware matches the specified type.

SSIDMatch.title: Wi-Fi names
SSIDMatch.description:
An array of SSIDs to match against the current network. If the network isn't a Wi-Fi network or if the SSID doesn't appear in this array, the match fails.
Omit this key and the corresponding array to match against any SSID.

URLStringProbe.title: Probe URL
URLStringProbe.description: A URL to probe. This rule matches when this URL is successfully fetched (returns a 200 HTTP status code) without redirection. Not available in watchOS.

PayloadCertificateUUID.title: Certificate UUID
PayloadCertificateUUID.description: The UUID of the certificate payload within the same profile to use for account credentials.

ProviderBundleIdentifier.title: Provider bundle ID
ProviderBundleIdentifier.description: The bundle identifier for the VPN provider. Not available in watchOS.

ProviderDesignatedRequirement.title: Provider designated requirement
ProviderDesignatedRequirement.description: If the VPN provider uses a system extension, this field is required. Not available in watchOS.

ProviderType.title: Provider type
ProviderType.description: The type of VPN service. If the value is app-proxy, the service tunnels traffic at the app level. If the value is packet-tunnel, the service tunnels traffic at the IP layer. Not available in watchOS.

RemoteAddress.title: Server
RemoteAddress.description: The IP address or hostname of the VPN server.

VPNSubType.title: VPN app bundle ID
VPNSubType.description:
An identifier for a vendor-specified configuration dictionary when the value for VPNType is VPN.

If VPNType is VPN, the system requires this field. If the configuration targets a VPN solution that uses a VPN plugin, then this field contains the bundle identifier of the plugin.

VPNType.title: Type
VPNType.description:
The type of the VPN, which defines which settings are appropriate for this VPN payload.

If the type is VPN or TransparentProxy, then the system requires a value for VPNSubType.

TransparentProxy is only available in macOS. L2TP and IPSec aren't available in tvOS. AlwaysOn is only available on iOS and AlwaysOn doesn't support Apple Watch pairing. For a previously paired Apple Watch, all phone-watch communications cease when AlwaysOn is enabled. Not available in watchOS.

VendorConfig.title: Vendor configuration dictionary
VendorConfig.description: The vendor-specific configuration dictionary, which the system reads only when VPNSubType has a value. Not available in watchOS.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: The group to connect to on the head end. Valid for Cisco AnyConnect and Cisco Legacy AnyConnect. Not available in watchOS.

LoginGroupOrDomain.title: Login group or domain
LoginGroupOrDomain.description: The login group or domain. Valid only for SonicWALL Mobile Connect. Not available in watchOS.

Realm.title: Realm
Realm.description: The Kerberos realm name, which needs to be properly capitalized. Valid only for Juniper SSL and Pulse Secure. Not available in watchOS.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: The role to select when connecting to the server. Valid only for Juniper SSL and Pulse Secure. Not available in watchOS.
